questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to emphasise the speaker’s surprise at the news?
options: It was surprising that she had never heard of the project before.
Never had she heard of the project before she saw it in the news.
She had never heard of the project before it was announced.
She was surprised to learn that the project had been underway for years.
questions.answer: It was surprising that she had never heard of the project before.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence correctly restates the idea that ‘the book’s themes of isolation were what most resonated with readers’?
options: What resonated most with readers was the book’s themes of isolation.
The themes of isolation were what resonated most with readers about the book.
Readers found the book’s isolation themes particularly compelling.
The book’s isolation themes were the subject of the most discussions.
questions.answer: What resonated most with readers was the book’s themes of isolation.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a third conditional to express regret about an opportunity missed?
options: If I had known about the conference, I would have attended.
If I had been invited, I would have gone to the party.
If she had been more prepared, she wouldn’t have failed the exam.
If he had studied harder, he wouldn’t have been accepted into the program.
questions.answer: If I had known about the conference, I would have attended.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical scenario where a policy change would be beneficial?
options: It is important that the government implements stricter environmental laws.
The government must enforce new regulations to protect wildlife.
If the budget were increased, we could fund more research projects.
She insisted that he should have taken the job offer.
questions.answer: If the budget were increased, we could fund more research projects.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis and formal register to describe a scenario where a speaker is discussing a complex negotiation?
options: The deal was agreed upon after many back-and-forth discussions.
They had a lengthy exchange, but the terms were finalised quickly.
The negotiations were so intricate that even the lawyers required clarification.
It was evident that both parties were committed to resolving the dispute amicably.
questions.answer: The deal was agreed upon after many back-and-forth discussions.
